characterList.description: A man with dark hair, often wearing a denim vest or a red shirt. He is initially arrogant and self-centered.
characterList.name: Emperor Kuzco

characterList.description: A woman with curly black hair, often wearing a dark purple and gold dress. She is the villainous advisor who wants to rule the kingdom.
characterList.name: Yzma

characterList.description: A large man with brown hair, often wearing a white tank top. He is Yzma's clumsy henchman.
characterList.name: Kronk

characterList.description: A black and white zebra. He is a selfish and sarcastic character.
characterList.name: Marty the Zebra

characterList.description: A large, muscular man with blond hair and a red suit with a black mask. He is a superhero who mistakenly rescues Marty.
characterList.name: Mr. Incredible (Bob Parr)

characterList.description: A hunchbacked man with red hair and a green tunic. He is part of Yzma's plan to eliminate Kuzco.
characterList.name: Quasimodo

characterList.description: Seven small men with different colored clothes and hats. They are also part of Yzma's plan.
characterList.name: Seven Dwarfs

characterList.description: Small, furry brown creatures with glowing green eyes. They try to attack Marty.
characterList.name: Fossa
